svg.title: RCWT-S decision readiness by context budget
svg.desc: Two-panel line chart for 64 synthetic sessions. The first panel compares decision readiness and the second compares stale-fact exposure for transcript tail, latest state, and first-state ablation treatments across construction token budgets.
